_comment: Canonical k6 bid-throughput sweep. 15s runs, single hot auction, local PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 (Docker), backend with RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100000000 BID_SEQUENCER=true BID_STREAM_BACKPRESSURE=100000. Direct = committed bids (201); Stream = enqueue acceptance (202). Latency percentiles over accepted requests only. Source: paper/figures/k6_<mode>_<vus>.json.

headline.note: Direct saturates: throughput plateaus ~57/s, p95 -> 1.23s, ~52% stale-400 rejections, 0 errors. Stream scales near-linearly with flat low latency and zero rejections/errors.
